description: Sums one meter's kWh in a readings file larger than the read cap, excluding voided rows and look-alike meter ids. DISTILL-CANARY-2f0a8037

files.meters/README.md:
# Meter readings

readings.csv has one row per reading, 4600 rows at export; kwh is in kWh.
flag=void rows were cancelled by the meter vendor and must not be counted; est rows are estimates and do count.
